reviews.text:
The staff were incredibly kind and helpful, which made me feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care.
Thanks to them, my dog ​​has recovered and is now very healthy.
I am deeply grateful to all the doctors and nurses. Thank you so much.

Our cat was in need of emergency care and Dr.Iwaki told us to come in right away and he helped us through it. We have visited him many times these past two weeks and he has been so caring of our cat and very communicative with us. A life saver! We don't know what we would have done without his help! We are so thankful to have found this hospital and Dr.Iwaki!

Thank you for your continued support. This time, I requested spaying surgery for my youngest cat (7-month-old female).

I was told that some cats are very energetic after the surgery, while others are lethargic. My cat was full of energy and ate well immediately after returning home.

She was moving around a lot, so I kept her in her cage overnight to avoid any potential danger.

The next day, she ate breakfast well, played with her older brother (my resident cat), and seemed very healthy. ☺️
It's been a week, and she seems to be recovering well.

I was worried about whether she could undergo surgery because she has a sensitive stomach, but I received a thorough explanation beforehand, and the surgery was performed only after her stomach was in good condition. The nurses also contacted me beforehand to check on her condition, which put my mind at ease.

I also appreciated the follow-up check-up the next day.

Thank you again for your continued support!

I had been going to a different hospital, but I wanted a second opinion regarding my dog's treatment, so I visited this clinic for the first time because of the good reviews.

The head veterinarian who treated my dog ​​not only gave me accurate advice based on the symptoms and the pros and cons, but also presented other possible options and explained them clearly. I'm so glad I decided to go and get their opinion.

I was incredibly worried before going, but thanks to them, I felt much more at ease and was able to make a decision with confidence.

Above all, because my dog ​​is such a precious member of my family, I wanted to make a well-informed decision, and I was so happy that they understood my concerns, explained things carefully, and thought through the options with me. I would definitely like to continue using their services in the future.

Thank you so much!!
My cat had infection and I was able to treat it with some English speaking vets here!

We've been relying on this hospital ever since we brought our pet home. When we first got him, he wasn't eating much, so we took him in for an examination. We discovered he had parasites, and after the treatment, he started eating well. Now he's a real foodie! Also, from around 3 to 4 years old, he frequently ingested things he shouldn't (partly due to my carelessness…), and we had him examined many times. It still happens occasionally, but each time, the appropriate treatment has prevented it from becoming serious, which has been a great relief. We're also grateful for the necessary actions taken based on the health check results.

The other day, we had Dr. Yasukawa, an orthopedic specialist, examine his hind leg knee joint, which had been a concern for a while. His explanation was kind and easy to understand, and we felt very relieved!

This hospital has many specialist departments, giving us peace of mind knowing we can always get our pet examined.

All the veterinarians and nurses are kind and warm, which we really appreciate!

We look forward to continuing our relationship with you.

I'm so glad I found a hospital where I can confidently entrust my beloved dog's future!

Noel, my Labrador, was diagnosed with hip dysplasia when he was a puppy, but now that he's 7 years old, I took him in for a check-up.

Dr. Yasukawa took the time to examine him carefully and thoroughly, explaining the test results and future care points in an incredibly easy-to-understand way, which gave me great peace of mind as a pet owner.

It turned out that he had chronic knee pain, not hip pain, and I was very grateful for the specific advice on how to walk him and how to minimize strain on his knees.

The nurses and reception staff were all very friendly and the hospital was clean and tidy, creating a welcoming atmosphere even for first-time visitors. I'm truly grateful for their reasonable treatment approach and gentle approach, which makes them trustworthy even for large dogs. I can confidently entrust Noel's future life to this hospital.

We have been consulting with this clinic about various things since we welcomed our dog into our home last year. We also had him undergo surgery for intraperitoneal testicles here. We also had him examined here when he had severe earwax buildup. The prognosis has been very good, and we have been able to live with peace of mind. Before any surgery or procedure, they always explain the advantages and disadvantages in an easy-to-understand way and carefully explain what should be done for our dog. We are always truly grateful to the head veterinarian and staff who listen to our concerns with such care. We look forward to continuing to use their services in the future!

I will never forget the day I rushed my beloved dog to HALU Animal Hospital when he developed pulmonary edema.

About two months prior, a regular check-up at our regular vet revealed a heart murmur and elevated BNP (cardiac hormone) levels. We were told to monitor him, but one day, he suddenly fell twice during a walk, and before dawn, his breathing became abnormal. I rushed him to HALU Animal Hospital, which has a cardiologist, at 8 AM.

He was immediately diagnosed with pulmonary edema, and thanks to the prompt treatment, his life was saved.

During his hospitalization, they kept me updated daily with careful phone calls and emails, which I remember greatly helping to ease my anxiety.

Afterward, he underwent regular cardiac examinations with Dr. Yu, and it turned out that a ruptured chordae tendineae was found. After surgery, he recovered completely.

I had to go to HALU Animal Hospital because there was no cardiologist available at our regular vet, but I'm so glad that Dr. Yu was able to treat him.

My pet has a very excitable temperament, but they were very considerate and took great care of him, such as letting us return him home early after the examination, which I was truly grateful for.
The peace of mind that comes from having him examined by a specialist is priceless.
This is a trustworthy hospital that genuinely cares about the lives of animals.
the doctor and staff are so friendly and supportive and they will do everything they can to help you and your lovely pet.

The doctors are very caring and attentive, and the nurses are kind. It's a wonderful hospital where you can feel everyone's love for animals.

We have three cats, and we all have them treated here because they saved our eldest cat.

Took my cat to get checked up and get his seizure medications. Everyone was really nice and Dr. K was great at handling my cat and explaining everything in English since I don't speak much Japanese yet. Highly recommend this clinic for your pet!

Thank you for visiting our clinic.

We are encouraged by your kind words, and we sincerely acknowledge any areas where we still need to improve. We will strive to provide even better medical care and services.

We look forward to your continued support.

10-year-old Bichon Frise with IBD
This is my first time posting a review.
I posted this in the hope that owners of dogs suffering for a long time will see it and that it might save even one life.
At the hospital we had been going to, medication wasn't improving her condition, she developed ascites, and could only eat a little. We were told that she wouldn't last a week if she stopped eating, and we had resigned ourselves to the fact that we had to say goodbye. However, we decided to get a second opinion and searched for another hospital, and happened to find HALU Animal Hospital.
Dr. Yu examined her, and he spoke to my dog ​​gently, thoroughly examined her condition, and provided accurate treatment and medication. My dog, whom we thought might not make it, has been getting healthier and healthier since the day we visited.

I am so grateful to the doctor and staff who are sharing in my child's joy as he/she gets better; it brings tears to my eyes. My child used to tremble uncontrollably whenever we went to the hospital, but thanks to the kind and compassionate care of Dr. Yu and the other doctors and staff at this hospital, he/she can now come without trembling. I am so grateful that you saved his/her life. Thank you for everything, and I look forward to your continued support.

I'm receiving treatment for epileptic seizures. The specialist doctor works closely with me, and the medication is prescribed and administered clearly according to my pet's condition, which gives me peace of mind.

The staff also greet me by my pet's name when I enter the clinic, which makes me feel very comfortable.

The veterinarians and nurses at Halu Animal Hospital were very professional and dedicated. We are extremely grateful for their care during Taeree-chan's illness. Taeree-chan received warm care during her two hospitalizations, and we received daily updates on Taeree-chan's condition via photos or videos. Their attentive service made us feel very reassured.

I highly recommend the hospital director, Dr. Yu, as he can communicate in Chinese to explain the illness and treatment methods; he's truly wonderful.
We appreciate your rating! If there’s anything we can do for you and your pet, feel free to reach out. See you next time!

As other reviewers have noted, the costs are far too high. The director told me that the preoperative blood tests and X-rays for my umbilical hernia would cost 20,000 yen, but the bill came to about 40,000 yen, including mysterious technical fees, electrolyte tests, and supplements. The surgery, which took place later, cost 100,000 yen plus hospitalization fees—more than three times the cost of other hospitals. This was too much to truly express my gratitude, so I went elsewhere. The other hospital said X-rays weren't necessary for this treatment, so the total was 50,000 yen. What's going on? What's more, this clinic requires half the surgery fee to be paid beforehand. Is it because they don't trust their customers or is it to prevent any problems? I visited because the reviews were relatively good, but I was left feeling very unsure. Frankly, I didn't want to leave my beloved dog in their care.
The diagnosis is accurate and the explanations are very easy to understand. The veterinarians and all the staff are very attentive and considerate. This is a very reliable animal hospital.

I've been seeing Dr. Yu ever since I had emergency surgery (intestinal obstruction). His diagnosis is spot-on, and his surgery is quick and skillful.
My original doctor told me I might not be able to tolerate anesthesia because I was too small, so he referred me here, and I transferred here. They use a very small endoscope, first to check my stomach, and then they open my abdomen and remove anything that had reached my intestines. Despite the sudden surgery, the staff were very kind to me, and I'm grateful for that. I was worried I wouldn't wake up from the anesthesia, but I woke up quickly after the surgery (the anesthesiologist seems to have administered it skillfully), and I was able to start a liquid diet the next day, and I was impressed by how quickly I recovered.
After I got home, I was back to normal, and the wound was so clean I almost thought I'd actually had surgery. I'm really glad I had the surgery here. The cost was about 1.5 times more than my original doctor, but I wouldn't trade it for my child's life. In fact, I even feel it's cheap because they provide such excellent medical care. I look forward to continuing to treat you well.

Thank you for your kind feedback! Our entire staff will continue to strive to ensure you can use our services with peace of mind. Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any problems or concerns.

Our cat, Mimu, has been a patient at HALU since she was one year old in 2021. We first visited HALU when she had severe chin acne and we heard they had a specialist. We were so grateful for the kind and thorough explanations from the doctor and nurses. Since then, we've frequently visited for ruptured anal glands, and Dr. Iwaki has always been her doctor. He always answers our questions accurately, and most importantly, he treats Mimu with such affection that we feel completely at ease leaving her in his care. For us pet owners, it's incredibly fortunate to have a hospital and doctor we can trust and rely on. We're so glad we found such a hospital. Recently, we've been going to the vet frequently, but Mimu has actually grown to enjoy the car rides, which has reduced the stress of going to the hospital, and both we and Mimu are actually enjoying it a little. We hope to continue receiving care there for many years to come. Thank you so much to all the doctors at HALU!
The head veterinarian, nurses, and receptionists all truly care about animals, and I'm so grateful. …

Dr Yu was really attentive to my cat & the nurses were all really friendly too. There was only one lady who constantly wanted people out of the clinic — saying they can’t wait here, or only one owner can wait. Some pets do have two owners. …

This hospital saved a weak kitten that had been given a terminal diagnosis at another hospital.
Two years have passed, but thanks to you, he is doing well. …
